## Preface
The word automation is sacred and lofty. It may be familiar to back-end development students, but for front-end development, it is indeed a bit out of reach. Next, I will share my automation practice in front-end projects.
## Implementation method
- One set is Docker + Jenkins that are often used in work. Jenkins is the key to continuous integration.
- Use DaoClound
What is continuous integration?
The cost of using Jenkins is still relatively high because it requires setting up the basic environment of Jenkins, but the usage rate is expected to be high. What I mainly introduce is the second solution, which is low-cost but can realize automated functions.
## Usage of DaoCloud
1. Host access and cluster management
You need to connect your virtual machine to Daocloud. See here for details.
1. Use Docker to build front-end applications

## Specific implementation steps
This is the process of automated construction of wo blog
1. Add the dockerfile file to the root directory of the project. The above content realizes the function of writing manual commands into scripts for automatic execution. dockerfile is a necessary configuration file to implement project containerization.
![image]()
1. Automated construction of the image (using github) The code source specifies the code warehouse location of your project. After the code source is associated, your operations on the code source will automatically trigger the corresponding actions of the project such as continuous integration and image building.  Select the target project, fill in the image name, and click Start Creation. Click the Go to Process Definition button. Click Manual Build to select the branch to be built. The above step indicates that the automated build is successful.
